data.name: Journey of Resurgence
data.detailed_description:
Genetic mutations, biological augmentation, wars of faith...

After enduring thousands of years of chaos and destruction, humanity awakens once again — only to find that the civilization they once built has vanished.

With their former glory lost, the remaining humans must rely on the protection of the World Tree, guarding the last spark of civilization.

In this resource-starved Age of Decline, the world’s surface begins to change.

Countless forms of life awaken intelligence, and new civilizations emerge across the wilderness — from frozen wastelands and endless deserts to ancient forests shrouded in eternal darkness.

Different species fight for survival, belief, and the future of their own kind.

And you will embark on a journey to uncover the truth behind this world.

From dense forests to barren deserts, from mysterious ruins to the sanctuary of the World Tree — a vast world filled with secrets awaits your discovery.

Choose your own path.

Every exploration and encounter may lead to new stories, hidden locations, strange events, and...

forgotten histories and legends of civilizations lost to time.

This world is home to many intelligent races, each with their own unique cultures, beliefs, and traditions.

Complete quests, aid different factions, and take part in their struggles to increase your reputation among various groups.

Your choices will shape how they see you and determine the support you receive.

Some may become trusted allies.

Others may stand against you because of the decisions you make.

This world is not simply filled with enemies.

You will encounter characters from different species, each carrying their own beliefs, regrets, desires, and dreams.

Through interactions, quests, and choices, uncover the stories hidden behind their struggles, conflicts, and emotions.

A world where civilization has collapsed, yet life continues to flourish in countless forms.

Civilization has fallen, and the old rules of the world no longer remain.

In this fallen age, there is no sheltered peace — only battles fought for survival.

Analyze enemy formations and the strengths of different species and classes.

Adjust your team composition, create unique strategies, and decide when to attack, defend, or retreat.

Every battle is a test of your survival instincts and tactical wisdom.

In a dangerous world where life continues to evolve, ordinary beings cannot survive for long.

Gather resources, research new technologies, and perform biological augmentations on your companions.

Replace body parts, enhance abilities, and create your own unique style of combat.

Every modification brings new appearances and ability combinations, transforming your companions into truly unique survivors of the apocalypse.

Why did the World Tree awaken?

Why did humanity fall?

What truly happened to this world?

As your journey continues, you will gradually uncover the truth buried beneath forgotten history.

But the truth...

may be something not everyone is willing to face.

During development, some visual assets and character voice lines were created with the assistance of AI tools and were further reviewed and edited by the development team.

data.short_description: In this open-world exploration game, you enter a mysterious post-apocalyptic world. With your companions, you’ll explore strange factions, collect, modify, ally with, or battle them, and uncover the hidden secrets of the world.
data.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (32bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible video card (integrated or dedicated with min 512MB memory)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit), Windows 11(64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD 1800 equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce 1060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content unsuitable for all ages, featuring general adult themes including violence, blood, mild nudity, or suggestive elements. The game is set in a post-apocalyptic world where players assume the role of a survivor and use weapons like swords, axes, and spears to defeat enemies. Combat scenes may include blood-splatter effects when characters are injured or killed. Some characters are depicted smoking or drinking, which introduces occasional use of tobacco or alcohol-related elements. Additionally, certain characters wear revealing clothing to emphasize personality traits; however, there is no explicit nudity or direct depiction of sexual activity.
